# Abdel Fattah el-Sisi in 2024: `1B.7` evidence note

**Working judgment:** **mixed, weakly positive**. The clearest 2024 evidence points to institution-building and civilian-technical framing on the positive side, but Sisi also kept relying on trusted insiders in the top security posts. I did **not** find a public 2024 case showing a clean shift from loyalist control to independent expert control in nuclear/security decisions.

|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|

That is direct evidence of an institutional-risk-reduction message. | `1B.7` |

This is not Egypt-specific staffing evidence, but it is the kind of risk-reducing institutional model relevant to the lens. | `1B.7`, `1B.3` |

| Negative / loyalist-heavy security staffing | [El Sisi names new chief of intelligence agency, replacing long-time close aide and confidant](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2024/10/16/el-sisi-names-new-chief-of-intelligence-agency-replacing-long-time-close-aide-and-confidant/) | The National, reporting Reuters | 2024-10-16 | https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2024/10/16/el-sisi-names-new-chief-of-intelligence-agency-replacing-long-time-close-aide-and-confidant/ | The intelligence chief was replaced by his deputy, and the outgoing chief became a presidential adviser. That cuts against a clean technocratic reading of the security apparatus. | `1B.7`, `1B.5` |

## Search gap / assessment

- I searched directly for 2024 evidence on `IAEA`, `nuclear safety`, `nuclear security`, `regulatory infrastructure`, and `defense` / `intelligence` reshuffles.
- I did **not** find a public 2024 case showing Sisi clearly moved nuclear/security decisions away from loyalists and toward independent expert control.
- I also did **not** find a public 2024 case of overt ideologue-driven nuclear/security decisionmaking.
- The strongest positive signals are **institutional language** and **IAEA engagement**. The strongest negative signals are the **continued reliance on trusted insiders** in core security posts.
- Net: the record supports only a **weakly positive** reading on institution-building, not a strong claim that Sisi prioritized expert insulation over loyalist control.
